title: [clinic · EX-10] Prove permission isolation
body:
> **Exercise clinic.** One long-running thread per exercise. Ask here rather than opening a
> new thread — the answers accumulate where the next person will look for them.
>
> **Exercise:** [`EX-10` — Prove permission isolation](https://github.com/akash-coded/nanorag/blob/main/docs/30-learning/exercises/ex-10-prove-permission-isolation.md) · difficulty 🔴

## What this exercise asks

Read the exercise first; this thread is for when you are stuck, not instead of it.

## Three ways people get stuck on this one

**1.** Testing that a permitted user *can* see a document. That is the easy half; the claim is about what they cannot see.

**2.** Post-filtering. Filtering after retrieval collapses `k` unpredictably and is not isolation, it is redaction — and the collapse is measurable as `k_collapse` in the trace.

**3.** Not testing the ANN path separately. Pre-filtering can disconnect the graph, which is a different failure from the exact path.

## How to ask here

Post the **numbers you got**, the **config that produced them**, and **what you already tried**.
A question with a measurement in it gets answered in one round trip; a question without one
takes three.

If you have finished it, post the write-up in **Show and Tell** with the
`[solution · EX-10]` prefix rather than here — this thread stays for people who are stuck.
